titleEn: Inter-Ministerial Prakas No. 491 on the Allocation of Revenue from Public Services and Penalties of the Ministry of Mines and Energy

articles.en:
_ The allocation of revenue from public services and revenue from penalties of the Ministry of Mines and Energy is determined as follows: A - Revenue from public services collected in implementation of Inter-Ministerial Prakas No. [illegible] dated [day and month illegible] 2024 on the provision of public services of the Ministry of Mines and Energy shall be allocated as follows: A.1 - Revenue from public services collected by the central administrative unit of the Ministry of Mines and Energy in respect of the types of services set out in Annex 1:
1 - Paid into the national budget — 44.5% of revenue collected
2 - Bonus of the Ministry of Mines and Energy — 54.5% of revenue collected. This bonus is divided into two parts: - Contribution to the Public Financial Management Reform Programme Fund — 10% of the bonus; - Used at the Ministry of Mines and Energy — 90% of the bonus
3 - Bonus of the Ministry of Economy and Finance — 1.0% of revenue collected.
Page 2 of 5
A.2 - Revenue from public services for which the Ministry of Mines and Energy delegates functions to the capital and provincial administrations, in respect of the types of services set out in Annex 2:
1 - Paid into the budget of the capital and provincial administration — 40.5% of revenue collected
2 - Bonus of the capital and provincial Departments of Mines and Energy — 54.5% of revenue collected
3 - Bonus of the capital and provincial administration — 3.0% of revenue collected
4 - Bonus of the General Department of Administration of the Ministry of Interior — 1.0% of revenue collected
5 - Bonus of the capital and provincial Departments of Economy and Finance — 1.0% of revenue collected.
B - Revenue from fines collected in implementation of Inter-Ministerial Prakas No. [illegible] dated [day and month illegible] 2024 on fines falling within the competence of the Ministry of Mines and Energy shall be allocated as follows: B.1 - Revenue from fines collected by the central administrative unit of the Ministry of Mines and Energy in respect of the types of offences set out in Annex 1:
1 - Paid into the national budget — 44.5% of revenue collected
2 - Bonus of the Ministry of Mines and Energy — 54.5% of revenue collected. This bonus is divided into two parts: - Contribution to the Public Financial Management Reform Programme Fund — 10% of the bonus; - Used at the Ministry of Mines and Energy — 90% of the bonus
3 - Bonus of the Ministry of Economy and Finance — 1.0% of revenue collected.
B.2 - Revenue from fines for which the Ministry of Mines and Energy delegates functions to the capital and provincial administrations, in respect of the types of offences set out in Annex 2:
1 - Paid into the budget of the capital and provincial administration — 40.5% of revenue collected
2 - Bonus of the capital and provincial Departments of Mines and Energy — 54.5% of revenue collected
3 - Bonus of the capital and provincial administration — 3.0% of revenue collected
4 - Bonus of the General Department of Administration of the Ministry of Interior — 1.0% of revenue collected
5 - Bonus of the capital and provincial Departments of Economy and Finance — 1.0% of revenue collected.
C - Revenue from pecuniary penalties imposed by decision of the courts, in respect of the types of offences falling within the competence of the Ministry of Mines and Energy, shall be allocated as follows: C.1 - Revenue collected by the central administrative unit of the Ministry of Mines and Energy:
1 - Paid into the national budget — 20.5% of revenue collected. Page 3 of 5
2 - Bonus of the Ministry of Mines and Energy — 54.5% of revenue collected. This bonus is divided into two parts: - Contribution to the Public Financial Management Reform Programme Fund — 10% of the bonus; - Used at the Ministry of Mines and Energy — 90% of the bonus
3 - Aggregate bonus of the competent courts — 24.0% of revenue collected
4 - Bonus of the Ministry of Economy and Finance — 1.0% of revenue collected.
C.2 - Revenue collected by the capital and provincial administration:
1 - Paid into the budget of the capital and provincial administration — 16.5% of revenue collected
2 - Bonus of the capital and provincial Departments of Mines and Energy — 54.5% of revenue collected
3 - Bonus of the capital and provincial administration — 3.0% of revenue collected
4 - Aggregate bonus of the competent courts — 24.0% of revenue collected
5 - Bonus of the General Department of Administration of the Ministry of Interior — 1.0% of revenue collected
6 - Bonus of the capital and provincial Departments of Economy and Finance — 1.0% of revenue collected.

_ The Ministry of Mines and Energy and the capital and provincial administrations are authorised to advance the aggregate bonus from the revenue collected and to disburse the share of the bonus to each target entity determined in Article 1 of this Inter-Ministerial Prakas.

_ Every month, the Ministry of Mines and Energy and the capital and provincial administrations shall settle the bonus advanced monthly in accordance with the procedure determined by the Ministry of Economy and Finance.

The bonus of the relevant ministries and institutions provided in Article 1 of this Inter-Ministerial Prakas is authorised to be used for the expenditure of allowances for civil servants and staff performing duties directly, and for other officials and staff, and for strengthening the revenue collection mechanism.
The provision of bonus allowances to civil servants of the Ministry of Mines and Energy shall comply with the decision of the Minister of Mines and Energy, on the basis of the principle of equity and according to work merit.
The provision of bonus allowances to civil servants of the Ministry of Economy and Finance shall comply with the decision of the Minister of Economy and Finance, on the basis of the principle of equity and according to work merit.
Page 4 of 5. The provision of bonus allowances to civil servants of the Ministry of Interior shall comply with the decision of the Minister of Interior, on the basis of the principle of equity and according to work merit.
The provision of bonus allowances to staff of the capital and provincial administrations shall comply with the decision of the Governor of the Board of Governors of the capital or province concerned, on the basis of the principle of equity and according to work merit.
Any provisions contrary to this Inter-Ministerial Prakas shall be considered null and void.

- The Director of Cabinet, the Secretaries General, the Directors General, the Inspectors General, the Directors of Department and the heads of relevant units of the Ministry of Mines and Energy and of the Ministry of Economy and Finance shall be responsible for implementing this Inter-Ministerial Prakas according to their respective duties from the date of signature onwards.
